Affirm and Shopify have launched Shop Pay Installments in Australia, allowing eligible shoppers to split purchases into fortnightly or monthly payments. Nitro Commerce has introduced Apps, an AI-powered tool that enables Shopify merchants to build private applications using prompts. Additionally, AnyMind Group has become a Premier Partner in the Shopify Partner Program, offering end-to-end support around Shopify. Furthermore, Shopify has connected Claude Commerce Agents to its catalogs and checkout, allowing assistants to search catalogs, build carts, and hand shoppers to checkout. Lastly, Shopify merchants can now advertise products directly inside ChatGPT, leveraging AI-driven conversations for targeted advertising.
